comment: There are exactly ten mfgSet references across the whole AAF install, and the
pack that plays most often here has one of them: Sleep_EyesClosed. The faces
are blank because nothing asks them to be anything else. This fills that in.
The sets are Rapport's own, in Data/AAF/Rapport_mfgSetData.xml, built from the
engine's own 50-entry facial morph table. No textures, no other mod, works on
"at" is a fraction of the scene's length, so the progression stretches to fit
however long a scene runs rather than being a list of seconds that goes wrong
the moment a scene is short.
A scene whose animations never carry an act tag is kissing or foreplay: it
gets kissSet for its whole length instead of building to a climax it is never
Expressions are applied with lock=true, which holds them against anything else
that would move the face. That is why clearSet exists and why everyone wearing
one is written into the save -- a scene that ends badly, or a save taken in the
middle of one, would otherwise leave somebody wearing it permanently.
comment_after: Afterwards: a dazed face for this many REAL seconds, then everything is
cleared. Real time is right here and game time is wrong -- this is about what
the player is watching, not about how long the day is.
